name: mariadb
description: Mariadb(https://mariadb.org/) is one of the most popular database servers. Made by the original developers of MySQL.

variables.name: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
variables.description: Set this to root password for installation (minimum 4 characters and non-alphanumeric passwords must be properly escaped). (valid only for first run)

variables.name: MYSQL_DATABASE
variables.description: Specify the name of a database to be created. (valid only for first run)

variables.name: MYSQL_USER
variables.description: This user will have superuser access to the database specified by MYSQL_DATABASE (do not use root here). (valid only for first run)

variables.name: MYSQL_PASSWORD
variables.description: Set this to the password you want to use for you MYSQL_USER (minimum 4 characters and non-alphanumeric passwords must be properly escaped). (valid only for first run)

variables.name: REMOTE_SQL
variables.description: Set this to ingest sql files from an http/https endpoint (comma seperated array).

variables.name: CLI_OPTS
variables.description: Pass CLI options to mariadbd via mariadbd-safe. Use with caution as mariadbd option precedence is complex.
